The bug in `/workspace/lru.py` was in the `put` method, where `self._store.popitem(last=True)` was being called. In an `OrderedDict`, `last=True` removes the *most* recently used item (the end of the dictionary), whereas an LRU cache should remove the *least* recently used item (the beginning of the dictionary).

I have updated the code to use `self._store.popitem(last=False)` to correctly evict the least recently used item.

```python
    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        if key in self._store:
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
        self._store[key] = value
        if len(self._store) > self.capacity:
            # FIX: pops the LEAST recently used item (first item in OrderedDict)
            self._store.popitem(last=False)
```
